title: A follow-up message sent just after an answer waits about 85 s for a computer
description: Live check 2026-10-10: turn 2 of a conversation was posted while owner 1 was still alive (owner exits about 12 s after the answer). By design one owner runs per computer, so no start job is published; the waiting turn only got its owner when a probe tick noticed owner 1 had stopped: owner running 84 s after the post. Required: when an owner exits and marks the computer stopped, publish start jobs for turns parked on that computer at once (in the same step that marks it stopped, or from the stopped-report route), so the wait is the owner exit time plus a start, not the probe interval. Keep one owner per computer. Scenario: a turn parked behind a live owner gets its start job within one step of the owner stopping. Mutation check. Related: TS-70 (start after a clean exit), computer_owner_single_writer.feature.
right_now_summary: A waiting turn starts only after a probe detects that its computer owner has stopped.
